about: Per-case exceptions to the Layer-1 fixtures (rust/echoport-command-guard/PLAN.md 4.4, 7.2). python_versions: cases where the Python guard decides differently under 3.12 and 3.13 (the generator fails on any unlisted one). rust: cases where the Rust guard may differ from the expected decision beyond the classes the generator tags with p3 (prefilter, invalid-utf8, python-error, policy-type, policy-trailing-newline). Each entry is {"id": <case id>, "reason": <why>}; S5 reviews every entry.
